source: https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Life_force, https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Death_Shroud, https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Reaper%27s_Shroud, https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Harbinger_Shroud, https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Ritualist%27s_Shroud (read 2026-09-08). Harbinger Shroud does not protect the health pool (protects_health false) and stacks Blight, which is not modeled. Ritualist's Shroud drain carries a wiki verification request. Life force is stored permanently on the life force pool (wiki `Life force`, read 2026-09-23), so a fight starts with the pool its player brought and a benchmark starts full. Scourge has no shroud: Manifest Sand Shade is F1 with no flip skill, so no row. `specialization` is the elite whose shroud the row is (API specialization ids 34 Reaper, 64 Harbinger, 76 Ritualist): the API tags every shroud entry skill spec-less, so the row, not the F1 id, says which shroud an elite wears. `unmodelled` names what a row's shroud does that the simulators do not play, for the gap line: Harbinger's Blight, and Corrupted Talent (every Harbinger's grandmaster minor, wiki `Corrupted Talent` read 2026-09-23: 'Allows shroud to be activated with no minimum life force'), so a Harbinger still pays the 10 % entry floor.
